Asset managers Grayscale and Coinshares have joined the race to launch a Litecoin (LTC) Spot ETF drawing reactions from the crypto community ranging from excitement to criticism. 
 
 
Litecoin Spot ETF: Crypto Community Weighs In
 
On January 24, Coinshares filed an S-1 registration form with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to launch the COINSHARES LITECOIN ETF (the “Trust”),  a spot exchange-traded fund that offers investors exposure to cryptocurrency LTC.
 
Meanwhile, Grayscale also filed a 19b-4 form with the securities regulator to list and trade its Grayscale Litecoin Trust, suggesting potential conversion to a Spot ETF.  In doing so, both asset managers join Canary Capital in a bid to launch the first Litecoin Spot ETF.
